strings.zh: 向南走入常磐森林,{NEWLINE}犹如进入了树木的迷宫。
strings.en: Head south into Viridian Forest, and{NEWLINE}it’s like entering a maze of trees.

strings.zh: 向北可前往月见山,{NEWLINE}仿佛投入了群山的怀抱。
strings.en: Head north toward Mt. Moon, and it’s{NEWLINE}like being embraced by the mountains.

strings.zh: 我在常磐森林仔细研究了{NEWLINE}虫系精灵的进食习惯,{CLEAR}然后从它们的吃东西动作中{CLEAR}总结了一个口袋妖怪的招式「虫蛀」。{CLEAR}你如果有精灵想学这个招式,{CLEAR}只要给我一个重复球,{CLEAR}我就可以教给它们。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I closely studied the eating habits of{NEWLINE}Bug-type Pokémon in Viridian Forest.{SCROLL}From the way they eat, I came up with a{NEWLINE}Pokémon move: Bug Bite.{SCROLL}If you have a Pokémon that wants to{NEWLINE}learn it, just give me one Repeat Ball,{CLEAR}and I’ll teach it.{SCROLL}How about it? Want to learn it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 要让哪个精灵学呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Which Pokémon should learn it?{SCROLL}
